unit_of_collection: one matched block containing exactly visual, hybrid, and playwright executions
provider_stratification: One provider/model profile per campaign invocation. Never pool providers or models.
protocol_boundary: Every execution must retain its own reset digest, independent oracle, randomization block, run record, and failure category.
An oracle-only success, connectivity check, diagnostic, or incomplete three-arm block is not a passed matched cell.
This campaign is exploratory and cannot freeze repetition counts or support confirmatory superiority claims.
coverage_gaps_before_conditional_claims: The remaining benchmark-matrix workflows need real three-arm controllers and independent oracles.
Indico and Juice Shop need live fault and UI-evolution controllers, not only labels in a manifest.
Each provider/model needs its own clean matched admission pilot before scale-up.
